# Steer, Don't Guess

> Steer, Don't Guess by Martin Jirgenson: a practical method (the Jirgenson Model) for setting priorities, reading the numbers and correcting course in business and life. Kindle, paperback, hardcover and PDF.

## Key facts

- Book: Steer, Don't Guess: Setting Priorities, Reading the Numbers and Correcting Course in Business and Life, by Martin Jirgenson (2026). Kindle: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HPBR6BNX
- Free: the Introduction and Chapter 1: https://mjirgensons.github.io/blog/free-sample/
- Free: the Jirgenson Model canon and operating prompt for ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini: https://mjirgensons.github.io/ai-assistant/
- Blind test E5 (final round): in the same 60 blind reviews, the judge flagged 102 invented facts in the answers of the AI on its own and 1 in the answers with the canon and prompt; answers with an invented fact 7 in 10 vs 1 in 120; score 56.2 vs 88.8 out of 100; preferred in 30 of 30 blind pairs. Limits: ten scenarios, one model family, an AI judge.
- Full record of the test, permanent DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23964934 (also on Hugging Face and Kaggle)
